errors.evidence: The description claims the vertical axis categories are arranged in ascending order ("възходящ ред"), but there is no inherent numerical or logical order to these categories; they are simply listed.

The description incorrectly identifies the color for the category "Много по-труден" (Much harder) as dark blue ("тъмносиньо"). The legend and the chart clearly show this category is represented by a light blue/cyan color.
